t: This is the site of the UK Holocaust Memorial, which was first proposed in 2015. It's meant to preserve the testimony of British Holocaust survivors and concentration camp liberators, and to honour Jewish and other victims of Nazi extermination, including Gypsies and disabled people. It was designed by the architect David Adjaye together with Ron Arad, the British-Israeli designer best known for his furniture, including the Rover chair. An older Holocaust memorial has stood in Hyde Park since 1984.
